description: Restyle the four content/flow screens to pixel-match Stitch: onboarding (01), sign-in (02), home dashboard (04), and the quran reader (06) including ayah_card. Presentational only — preserve every provider/controller call and public API. Depends on FEAT-001 (theme + shared widgets) and FEAT-002 (new routes /reader/:id). After it, these screens match the HTML and the app builds.
steps: Read design-mapping.md §2 (screens 01, 02, 04, 06), §5 (data contracts), §0 (adab/content rules) and context.json. Activate the flutter-feature skill before editing. Read each target file before modifying it.

Onboarding (mobile/lib/features/onboarding/onboarding_screen.dart): full body rewrite to the minimal image-centric design — soft vertical gradient #fbfaf7->#f4f8f6 (local const, cite source HTML), centered 'Hudaayah' wordmark (headlineMedium/primary), hero assets/images/onboarding-hero.jpg (BoxFit.contain) in a rounded-3xl clipped container with a radial feathered fade (ShaderMask radial or RadialGradient overlay) + ambient blur bloom, headline 'Your journey with the Quran.' + subtitle 'Build a beautiful daily habit, one verse at a time.', a full-width rounded-full PrimaryPillButton 'Get started' (trailing arrow) -> context.go('/auth'), and an 'Already have an account? Sign in' link -> context.go('/auth'). Remove the old pillars/_PillarCard and the hardcoded Basmala block.

Sign-in (mobile/lib/features/authentication/presentation/sign_in_screen.dart): restyle per §2 screen 02 while preserving authControllerProvider, signInWithGoogle(), the error ref.listen SnackBar, loading spinner, disabled Apple button ('coming soon'), ToS/Privacy rich text, and AppConfig.qfAttribution. Use AuthProviderButton for Google/Apple (h-56 rounded-2xl surface-container-lowest), InfoCard for the 'Sacred Data Sanctuary' trust note, the account-setup pill top bar, and the stacked-tile emblem (Icons.auto_awesome in secondaryContainer; no emblem.png asset).

Home (mobile/lib/features/progress/presentation/home_screen.dart): restyle per §2 screen 04 preserving progressSummaryProvider, dueReviewsProvider, authControllerProvider name, RefreshIndicator+invalidate, loading/error/retry. Add HudaayahTopBar(tab 'Home') + StreakChip(summary.streak); greeting 'Assalamu Alaikum, <name>' (displaySmall) + subtitle; a feature-local HabitCard (primary-container, title 'Surah Al-Fatihah', 'Ayah 1-7 • The Opening' transliteration subtitle, ProgressRing honest 0/100 from first lesson completion, 'Continue Reading' -> context.go('/reader/1')); a feature-local LessonJourneyTile list from summary.lessons (completed=primary-fixed check + 'Completed'; in-progress=secondary-fixed + 'In Progress'); keep the Review CTA from dueReviewsProvider -> /review; footer AppConfig.qfAttribution. OMIT 'Word of the Day' and live Hijri date (no data source; would require hardcoded content).

Reader (mobile/lib/features/quran_reader/presentation/reader_screen.dart): restyle per §2 screen 06 preserving lessonProvider, audioControllerProvider (playAyah/toggleLoop/state), the audio-error ref.listen SnackBar, loading/error retry, Lesson.attribution, the 'Practice this lesson' CTA. Replace _ReciterStrip with a feature-local AudioStrip (round primary-container play button bound to audio state, reciter label, 1.0x speed chip + repeat toggle bound to audio.looping/toggleLoop, a static scrub track — NO fake timer since the controller exposes no position). Add a feature-local ReaderFloatingControls pill (A-/A+ font size + Translation visibility toggle + tune; local widget state only, no API). Any Basmala/surah header must come from lesson content, not a new hardcoded Arabic string (show surah metadata chip only if not separable). Keep the QF attribution block.

Ayah card (mobile/lib/features/quran_reader/presentation/ayah_card.dart): restyle to the HTML ayah card — verse-key badge (secondary-fixed), Juz chip, RTL Arabic via AppTheme.arabicAyahLg (fontFamily 'UthmanicHafs' kept, with its silent fallback) + end-of-ayah marker, italic transliteration via AppTheme.transliteration, translation (bodyLarge) clearly labeled, and a surface-container-low bottom action row (play_circle/translate/content_copy). Keep the three distinct content layers, the existing audio button wiring, and _WordChip.
Run the verification gate and record results in findings. Confirm NO new hardcoded Quran verse text was introduced in any edited file.
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding is the minimal image-centric screen (hero jpg, 'Your journey with the Quran.', rounded-full Get started + Sign in link); no card carousel or hardcoded Basmala remains.
Sign-in keeps Google wiring + disabled Apple + trust card + ToS/Privacy + QF attribution, restyled to the Stitch layout.
Home shows the top bar, streak chip, habit card with progress ring + Continue Reading -> /reader/1, and the journey list from real summary.lessons; Word of the Day and live Hijri are omitted.
Reader shows the audio strip (bound to audioController), floating controls, Stitch ayah cards with 3 distinct layers and UthmanicHafs fallback, and QF attribution; no fabricated audio progress.
No edited file contains newly hardcoded Quran ayah/verse text as canonical data; Arabic renders RTL with diacritics from the model layer.
flutter analyze reports zero new errors and the app builds.
verification: cd mobile && flutter build apk --debug  (fallback: flutter build web / analyze-only — record which ran)
findings:
ONBOARDING (lib/features/onboarding/onboarding_screen.dart): full body rewrite to the minimal image-centric design. OnboardingScreen stays StatelessWidget. Soft vertical gradient const _onboardingGradient (#fbfaf7->#f4f8f6, cited to 01-welcome-onboarding.html) on a full-bleed Container. SafeArea + Padding(24,24,24,32) + Column: centered 'Hudaayah' wordmark (headlineMedium/primary); Expanded _HeroIllustration = assets/images/onboarding-hero.jpg (BoxFit.contain) in a ClipRRect(radius3xl) with a ShaderMask RADIAL feathered fade (BlendMode.dstIn, stops 0.6->1.0) over an ambient secondary-fixed/0.2 blur bloom (ImageFiltered blur 40); headline 'Your journey with the Quran.' (headlineMedium/primary/center); subtitle 'Build a beautiful daily habit, one verse at a time.' (bodyMedium/onSurfaceVariant, maxWidth 270); PrimaryPillButton 'Get started' -> context.go('/auth'); 'Already have an account? Sign in' rich text, 'Sign in' bold+underlined/primary -> context.go('/auth'). REMOVED the old _PillarCard trio, the pillars list, the hardcoded Basmala block, and the onboarding QF attribution line (design 01 does not show attribution; it lives on content screens). No Quran text remains on this screen.

SIGN-IN (lib/features/authentication/presentation/sign_in_screen.dart): restyled per design 02; ALL wiring preserved verbatim — authControllerProvider watch, ref.listen error SnackBar (ApiException/GoogleSignInException/other), isLoading disabling + spinner, AppConfig.qfAttribution, ToS/Privacy rich text. Padding 20. Added _TopBar (circular back _CircleButton -> context.go('/onboarding'); centered 'ACCOUNT SETUP' pill with amber dot; help _CircleButton no-op) and _Emblem (two rotated primaryFixed/secondaryFixed tiles behind a surface-container-lowest tile holding Icons.auto_awesome in secondaryContainer — no emblem.png asset). Google + Apple now use the shared AuthProviderButton: Google leading=_GoogleGlyph (painted 'G', simple/themed) + onPressed signInWithGoogle (null while loading, spinner leading); Apple leading=Icons.apple + onPressed:null (kept 'coming soon' label). Trust note now the shared InfoCard(lock_outline, 'Sacred Data Sanctuary', ...). Removed the old _TrustCard. NOTE: go_router import is required here (context.go) — do not drop it.

HOME (lib/features/progress/presentation/home_screen.dart): restyled per design 04; HomeScreen stays ConsumerWidget. Preserved progressSummaryProvider (when loading/error/data), dueReviewsProvider (maybeWhen Review CTA -> /review), authControllerProvider displayName, RefreshIndicator + invalidate(progressSummaryProvider/dueReviewsProvider) + await future, loading spinner + _CenteredRetry. Layout = Column[ HudaayahTopBar(tab:'Home', streakDays: summary.streak), Expanded(RefreshIndicator(ListView[...])) ]. Greeting 'Assalamu Alaikum, <name>' (displaySmall/primary) + subtitle. HabitCard (NEW feature-local) title 'Surah Al-Fatihah', subtitle 'Ayah 1-7 • The Opening' (rendered via AppTextStyles.transliteration so it reads as an educational label, NOT Quran text), ProgressRing percent = 1.0 if first lesson completed else 0.0 (honest), button 'Continue Reading'/'Review Al-Fatihah' -> context.go('/reader/1'). _JourneyList maps summary.lessons to LessonJourneyTile (NEW feature-local). Footer AppConfig.qfAttribution. OMITTED (per spec/§8): 'Word of the Day', live Hijri/'14 Ramadan' chip (no neutral chip rendered — simply omitted), and the Adhkar reminder — all lack a data source and would require hardcoded content. REMOVED the old _DailyGoalCard (design 04 shows no daily-goal bar on the home card); summary.dailyGoal is still a model field, no provider/API changed.

HOME FEATURE-LOCAL WIDGETS: lib/features/progress/presentation/widgets/habit_card.dart -> HabitCard({required String title, String subtitle, double percent, String buttonLabel, VoidCallback onContinue}); uses ProgressRing. lib/.../widgets/lesson_journey_tile.dart -> LessonJourneyTile({required String title, String subtitle, bool completed, VoidCallback? onTap}); completed=primaryFixed check tile + 'Completed' chip, else secondaryFixed tile + amber 'In Progress' chip.

READER (lib/features/quran_reader/presentation/reader_screen.dart): CHANGED FROM ConsumerWidget TO ConsumerStatefulWidget to hold local-only reader prefs: double _fontScale (0.8..1.6) and bool _showTranslation. Preserved lessonProvider(widget.lessonId) (when loading/error/data), audioControllerProvider watch, the audio-error ref.listen SnackBar, _ErrorRetry + invalidate, Lesson.attribution footer, 'Practice this lesson' CTA -> context.go('/lesson/<id>/practice'). AppBar: centered 'Surah Reader' title + back button (context.pop() if canPop else go('/surah')). Replaced _ReciterStrip with the NEW feature-local AudioStrip, and added the NEW feature-local ReaderFloatingControls in a bottom Positioned+Center over a Stack. AudioStrip main play button is bound to the FIRST ayah that has a non-null audioUrl (_firstAudioAyah); playing/loading are derived from audio.verseKey match + audio.playing/loading; onPlayPause calls playAyah(verseKey, audioUrl!); disabled (null) if no ayah has audio. Loop toggle bound to audio.looping/toggleLoop. No fake position/timer — the scrub track is a static bar (AudioController exposes no position). ReaderFloatingControls A-/A+ mutate _fontScale, Translation toggle mutates _showTranslation, tune is a no-op (local state only, no API). The decorative Basmala/surah-header card from the mock was NOT added as standalone Arabic (would be hardcoded verse text) — only the reciter/surah metadata label 'Surah Al-Fātiḥah' (a surah NAME, not verse text) appears in the AudioStrip.

READER FEATURE-LOCAL WIDGETS: lib/features/quran_reader/presentation/widgets/audio_strip.dart -> AudioStrip({required String surahTitle, String reciterLabel, bool playing, bool loading, bool looping, VoidCallback? onPlayPause, VoidCallback onToggleLoop}). lib/.../widgets/reader_floating_controls.dart -> ReaderFloatingControls({required bool translationVisible, VoidCallback onDecreaseFont, onIncreaseFont, onToggleTranslation, VoidCallback? onTune}).

AYAH CARD (lib/features/quran_reader/presentation/ayah_card.dart): restyled to the design-06 card; stays ConsumerWidget. PUBLIC CONTRACT EXTENDED (backward-compatible, both new params default so existing callers are unaffected): AyahCard({required Ayah ayah, double fontScale = 1.0, bool showTranslation = true}). Three distinct layers kept: (1) sacred Arabic rendered via AppTextStyles.arabicAyahLg (fontFamily 'UthmanicHafs' with silent fallback), RTL, scaled by fontScale, with an end-of-ayah marker built from \u06DD + Arabic-Indic numeral of the verse number (decorative marker, NOT verse text); (2) word-by-word chips using word.transliteration (italic AppTextStyles.transliteration) + word.translation; (3) translation (bodyLarge) under a 'TRANSLATION' label, hidden when showTranslation=false. Verse-key badge is secondaryFixed/onSecondaryFixed; 'Juz 1' chip on surfaceContainer. Bottom action row on surface-container-low with play_circle (wired to existing playAyah), translate (decorative, onPressed:null) and content_copy (decorative, onPressed:null). ALL Quran Arabic/translation/transliteration still comes from the Ayah model (QF/backend) — no new hardcoded verse text. Kept _WordChip.

TEST UPDATE (test/widget_test.dart): the single existing widget test 'App boots to onboarding with QF attribution' asserted the OLD onboarding (hero copy 'Build a Heartfelt', CTA 'Get Started — It's Free', a Scrollable, and onboarding QF attribution) — all of which FEAT-003 intentionally removes per design 01 + design-mapping §8 assumption 2. Updated the test to assert the redesigned onboarding: 'Hudaayah' wordmark, 'Your journey with the Quran.', 'Build a beautiful daily habit...', 'Get started', and 'Sign in'. This was aligning a stale test with the user-requested Stitch design, not a behavior change beyond the design, so no send_message warning was raised.

SHARED WIDGETS REUSED AS-IS (no signature changes): PrimaryPillButton, AuthProviderButton, InfoCard, HudaayahTopBar (which itself renders StreakChip when streakDays != null and the 'هد' avatar), ProgressRing. FEAT-002's /reader/:id and /lesson/:id/complete routes and the Read->/surah branch were relied on unchanged; all reader/home nav uses context.go('/reader/1') / '/reader/<id>'.

NOTES FOR LATER FEATs: (a) AyahCard now accepts fontScale/showTranslation (defaults preserve prior behavior) — reuse them if other screens embed ayah cards. (b) AudioStrip/ReaderFloatingControls are quran_reader feature-local, not in core/widgets. (c) The reader has NO decorative Basmala header card; if a later FEAT wants it, the Arabic must come from lesson content (ayah model), never a literal. (d) HabitCard/LessonJourneyTile are progress feature-local and parameterised, reusable by exercises/profile if needed.

VERIFICATION / BUILD GATE THAT ACTUALLY RAN (worktree mobile/):
  flutter pub get  => 'Got dependencies!' (OK; 20 transitive packages have newer incompatible versions — pre-existing, unrelated).
  flutter analyze  => 'No issues found! (ran in 12.5s)' — 0 errors/warnings/infos (after adding the go_router import to sign_in_screen.dart that the first analyze flagged).
  flutter test  => 'All tests passed!' (1 widget test, updated as above). NOTE: FEAT-001/002 reported flutter test blocked by an objective_c native-assets hook; in THIS run the test suite ran and passed cleanly — the earlier blocker did not reproduce.
  flutter build apk --debug  => '✓ Built build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk' (Gradle assembleDebug ~28s; the warmed Gradle cache let the full compile gate succeed this time, unlike FEAT-001/002 which only had analyze). GATE USED = full set: pub get + analyze + test + build apk --debug, ALL GREEN.
